name: Pebble Beetle
script:
on tick every 20:
 if rand(10) < 2 then walk to garden; frame 2 end
end
on near: if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat; say 1 end; end
on poke: say 2; hop 8; end

name: Teacup Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; say 1; end
on weather stormy: emit sparkle; end

name: Bubble Jelly
script:
on tick every 12:
 mem[0] = mem[0] % 3 + 1; frame mem[0]
end
on poke: float 8; say 1; burst sparkle; end
on weather rainy: say 2; emit puff; end

name: Moss Armchair
script:
on near moss: say 1; emit zzz; end
on time night: emit zzz; end
on poke: say 2; emit heart; end

name: Thumb Fern
script:
on weather rainy: frame 3; emit sparkle; end
on weather sunny: frame 2; end
on tick every 40: if rand(10) == 0 then frame 1 + rand(3) end; end
on poke: say 1; end

name: Clockwork Mouse
script:
on tick every 16:
 if rand(8) == 0 then walk to anywhere; sound clock end
end
on poke: say 1; hop 10; frame 2; end
on near critter: if has(neartraits, clockwork) then say 2; emit heart else face end; end
on jam jammed: say 3; walk to works; end

name: Tin Music Box
script:
on poke:
 frame 2; sound tune; emit note; say 1
end
on near: if has(neartraits, music) then emit note; say 2 end; end
on hour 20: sound tune; burst note; end

name: Glass Wind Chime
script:
on world breeze: sound ding; burst note; frame 2; end
on weather stormy: sound ding; frame 3; end
on poke: sound ding; say 1; frame 1 + rand(3); end

name: Dandelion Puff
script:
on world breeze: burst puff; float 12; say 1; end
on poke: emit puff; frame 2; say 2; end
on tick every 30: if rand(20) == 0 then emit puff end; end

name: Toadstool Stool
script:
on near snail: say 1; frame 2; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit sparkle; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on poke: hop 4; sound boing; end

name: Sugar Cube Golem
script:
on weather rainy: say 1; walk to high; end
on near: if has(neartraits, wet) then say 2; walk to dock end; end
on poke: say 3; hop; emit sparkle; end
on world ants: say 1; walk to anywhere; end

name: Brass Owl Clock
script:
on hour: sound clock; frame 2; wait 4; frame 1; end
on hour 0: say 1; sound horn; end
on time night: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; say 2; end

name: Firefly Jar
script:
on time night: glow on; frame 2; end
on time day: glow off; frame 1; end
on tick every 8: if time == night and rand(10) < 3 then emit sparkle end; end
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end

name: Paper Boat
script:
on world leak: say 1; float 10; sound splash; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; say 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on poke: float; flip; end

name: Honey Pot
script:
on near critter: if has(neartraits, wild) then say 1 else emit heart end; end
on world ants: say 2; emit puff; end
on poke: emit heart; say 1; end

name: Woolly Caterpillar
script:
on tick every 10:
 mem[0] = mem[0] % 3 + 1; frame mem[0]
 if rand(20) == 0 then walk to garden end
end
on berry: seek plant; eat; say 1; end
on poke: say 2; emit heart; end
on time night: say 3; emit zzz; end

name: Hanging Fern Basket
script:
on berry: frame 2; emit sparkle; end
on world bloom: burst heart; frame 2; say 1; end
on poke: frame 1; emit puff; end

name: Rubber Duck
script:
on poke: sound boing; say 1; frame 2; end
on world leak: float 16; say 2; sound splash; end
on near: if has(neartraits, wet) then sound chirp; flip end; end

name: Little Pot Stove
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; emit puff; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on weather snowy: glow on; say 1; end
on near: if has(neartraits, food) then sound fizz; say 2 end; end

name: Cactus Buddy
script:
on bumped: say 1; sound crunch; end
on weather sunny: frame 2; say 2; end
on weather rainy: frame 1; end
on poke: say 2; end

name: Tin Robot
script:
on jam jammed: walk to works; say 1; sound clock; end
on jam fixed: say 2; burst sparkle; hop 10; end
on tick every 24: if rand(10) == 0 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2) end; end
on poke: say 3; boost 10; end

name: Snail Bell
script:
on tick every 20: if sulking then nudge; sound ding; say 1; frame 2 end; end
on poke: sound ding; frame 2; say 2; end
on shipped: frame 1; end

name: Moon Moth
script:
on time night: fly; glow on; end
on time dawn: home; glow off; say 1; end
on poke: frame 2; emit sparkle; say 2; end

name: Crystal Geode
script:
on time dawn: frame 2; burst sparkle; end
on time day: frame 1; end
on poke: emit sparkle; say 1; end
on near: if has(neartraits, shiny) then emit sparkle end; end

name: Cloud Puff
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit puff; say 1; end
on weather stormy: frame 3; sound bang; shake; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; say 2; end
on poke: float; say 3; end

name: Tiny Bookshelf
script:
on time night: say 1; emit zzz; end
on poke: say 2; sound plop; end
on new: if has(newtraits, spooky) then say 1 end; end

name: Pumpkin Sprout
script:
on time dawn: mem[0] += 1; if mem[0] > 3 then mem[0] = 3 end; frame mem[0]; end
on poke: say 1; end
on time night: if days > 2 then glow on; say 2 end; end
on time day: glow off; end

name: Ladybird
script:
on tick every 20: if rand(12) == 0 then seek plant; frame 2 end; end
on world ants: say 1; walk to garden; end
on poke: hop 12; frame 1; say 2; end

name: Paper Bat
script:
on time night: frame 2; say 1; sound whoosh; end
on time day: frame 1; emit zzz; end
on world dark: burst puff; say 2; end
on poke: flip; end

name: Bath Sponge
script:
on world leak: frame 2; say 1; sound splash; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; say 2; end
on poke: emit puff; sound plop; end

name: Kite Fish
script:
on world breeze: float 20; say 1; frame 2; end
on tick every 40: if rand(10) == 0 then flip end; end
on poke: burst note; say 2; end

name: Rocking Chair
script:
on tick every 6: if mem[0] > 0 then mem[0] -= 1; frame 1 + mem[0] % 2 end; end
on poke: mem[0] = 12; sound clock; say 1; end
on time dusk: mem[0] = 8; end

name: Bramble Pup
script:
on near: if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat; say 1 elif has(neartraits, soft) then emit heart end; end
on poke: hop 10; sound chirp; say 2; end
on world visitor: walk to dock; say 3; end
on tick every 30: if rand(15) == 0 then drop end; end

name: Bell Flower
script:
on time dawn: frame 2; sound ding; end
on time dusk: frame 1; end
on world bloom: burst heart; say 1; end
on poke: sound ding; say 2; end

name: Thimble Gramophone
script:
on poke: if playing then say 1 else sound tune; frame 2; burst note; say 2 end; end
on tick every 8: if playing and rand(4) == 0 then emit note end; end
on shipped: sound tune; end

name: Star Mobile
script:
on tick every 16: mem[0] = mem[0] % 3 + 1; frame mem[0]; end
on time night: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end

name: Dust Bunny
script:
on tick every 20: if rand(10) == 0 then walk to anywhere; emit puff end; end
on world breeze: hop 16; say 1; end
on near moss: frame 2; say 2; end
on time night: emit zzz; end

name: Soap Bubble
script:
on bumped: burst sparkle; sound pop; frame 2; end
on poke: sound pop; float; say 1; end
on tick every 30: if rand(10) == 0 then float end; end

name: Signal Flag
script:
on shipped: frame 2; say 1; signal 7; end
on jam jammed: frame 1; say 2; sound horn; end
on poke: flip; end

name: Mushroom Lamp
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on weather foggy: glow on; say 1; end
on signal 7: burst sparkle; say 2; end
